2026-08-30 fix: the mask actually used here covered ~41% of the frame (nearly the whole dog + surrounding floor/furniture) instead of a small local area, so denoise=1 was regenerating almost the entire subject. Negative expand erodes the mask inward by this many pixels before inpainting -- codex_reviewer measured that on that specific ~701x401px mask, -60 only gets down to ~581x281px (still ~18% of the frame), because eroding a whole-subject-sized mask converges toward a useless sliver long before it converges toward a properly local patch. This node is a seam-margin safety net, NOT a substitute for drawing a tight mask around the actual defect in ComfyUI's mask editor -- that redraw is still required every time.
